title: Efficacy of Novel GLP-1/GIP Dual Agonist in Type 2 Diabetes
eligibility_text:
INCLUSION CRITERIA:
Diagnosis of type 2 diabetes mellitus confirmed by a physician.
HbA1c between 6.5% and 10.0% at screening visit.
eGFR >= 45 mL/min/1.73m² at screening.
BMI 25 to 40 kg/m².

EXCLUSION CRITERIA:
Current use of insulin therapy.
Current use of GLP-1 receptor agonist within 3 months of screening.
Severe hepatic impairment.
Willingness to attend monthly clinic visits is required.

title: Once-Weekly SGLT2 Inhibitor Formulation in Adults with T2DM
eligibility_text:
INCLUSION CRITERIA:
Type 2 diabetes mellitus diagnosis (SNOMED 44054006) for at least 12 months.
HbA1c between 7.5% and 11.0% at screening.
BMI >= 27 kg/m².

EXCLUSION CRITERIA:
Severe renal impairment defined as eGFR < 30 mL/min/1.73m².
Current treatment with SGLT2 inhibitor.
History of recurrent urinary tract infections.
Participation in another clinical trial within 30 days.

title: Oral Semaglutide vs Empagliflozin in Overweight T2DM Patients
eligibility_text:
INCLUSION CRITERIA:
Confirmed type 2 diabetes mellitus.
HbA1c 7.0% to 12.0% at baseline.
eGFR >= 30 mL/min/1.73m².

EXCLUSION CRITERIA:
Current treatment with GLP-1 agonist or dual GIP/GLP-1 agonist.
History of severe hypoglycaemia in the past 12 months.
Uncontrolled hypertension (>160/100 mmHg).
Self-monitoring of blood glucose willingness required.

title: Completed Phase III Metformin Add-On Study
eligibility_text:
INCLUSION CRITERIA:
Type 2 diabetes. HbA1c between 7.0% and 10.0%.

EXCLUSION CRITERIA:
Contraindication to metformin.

title: Paediatric and Young Adult T2DM Registry
eligibility_text:
INCLUSION CRITERIA:
Type 2 diabetes diagnosis before age 25.
HbA1c > 6.5%.

EXCLUSION CRITERIA:
Age over 25 years at enrolment.
